dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature (falcate) from the apex down to the posterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is acute with a small-radius rounded tip.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, semi-circular convexity with a medium-sized radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum; length is roughly equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle, approximately 135 degrees, at the point of inflection between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-to-teal gradient coloration across the entire 3D model surface with no pixel-level biological texture.
